title: ADAS Sensor Calibrations Customer Relations Memo: Lifetime Warranty Member Rate on the Calibration Price
content:
The member rate on the calibration price of an ADAS Sensor Calibrations customer-pay order is **0.96** where the vehicle holds an active network lifetime workmanship warranty (a Certified Structural Lifetime Warranty or a Collision Lifetime Workmanship Warranty) issued no more than 365 days before the acceptance, **0.98** where it holds such an active warranty issued earlier, and **1** where it holds none.

The rate acts on the tier's calibration price itself, and the calibration quote so rated is rounded to the cent, half up.

## Records the rate is read from

The vehicle's Workmanship Warranties records with the network: the warranty's name, its status and its issued date. The warranties that count are a Certified Structural Lifetime Warranty or a Collision Lifetime Workmanship Warranty in active status. Days are calendar days counted from the issued date to the day of the acceptance, the issued date not counted.

## Rate by the vehicle's warranty holding

| Active Certified Structural Lifetime Warranty or Collision Lifetime Workmanship Warranty on the vehicle | Days from issue to the acceptance | Member rate |
|---|---|---|
| held | no more than 365 | 0.96 |
| held | more than 365 | 0.98 |
| none held | — | 1 |

## Boundary cases (hypothetical)

- Active Certified Structural Lifetime Warranty issued 365 days before the acceptance: 0.96; issued 366 days before: 0.98.
- The vehicle's only warranty is a Glass Installation Lifetime Warranty: it is not one of the two warranties that count, and the rate is 1.

## Illustration (hypothetical calibration price of 349.00 USD)

At 0.96 the quote is 335.04 USD; at 0.98 it is 342.02 USD.
